text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to push the v2.4.3 version bump + changelog today. Cutoff is 18:00 PST. Doing a CI green-sweep at 16:30. Call out any open flaky tests or urgent fixes now.

alex: On it, will run green sweep in ~20m. PR is up for the bump. Any migration notes?

maria: No DB migrations, just a config flag rename (service.cache.enabled -> service.cache.v2). Changelog bullets should mention cache behavior change.

jordan: FYI I'm seeing intermittent failures in tests/integration/streaming_cache.test on mac runners — reproduces ~20% locally.

chris: If you can't get a quick fix, we can quarantine the test for the release. @buildkite-bot can you rerun job 6789 with mac label?

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Rerun requested by chris for job #6789 — queued on macos-12-runner.

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Job #6789 completed — ✅ passed (2m 12s). Seems infra-y; tagging observation.

jordan: Thanks, not reproducible now. I'll add an @flaky annotation and open a tiny PR to skip under mac until follow-up.

sara: Changelog nudge: please add concise bullets to the template. I prefilled a 'performance' bullet for the cache improvements.

alex: Version bump PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/v2.4.2...v2.4.3 — needs one more review from @jordan or @maria.

maria: I'll review in ~10. Release checklist updated in /docs/releases/handbook.md — reminder: upload release asset to S3 if >50MB.

qa-bot: qa-bot: nightly-e2e at 15:00 — 1 failure (streaming_cache) — https://ci.redwood/12345.

chris: If nightly is failing, we should verify it's flaky vs regression before cutting. Jordan, can you confirm?

jordan: Quick triage: looks flaky, not a functional regression. Opened issue #432 and PR #8345 to skip on mac for now; will follow up post-release.

maria: OK proceed with bump + changelog. Cutoff remains 18:00 PST. @alex merge after my review and trigger the release pipeline. If we observe >3 new flakes during the green sweep, pause the rollout.

alex: Will merge on LGTM and trigger the release pipeline (using the 'release' Buildkite pipeline). Green sweep scheduled for 16:30 PST.

sara: :thumbsup: I'll draft the release notes page and ping marketing.

chris: I'll keep an eye on post-release CI. If we see regression spikes, I can flip fallback to v2.4.2 per rollback playbook.

maria: :rocket: thanks team. Final reminder: if you're pushing infra changes (eg. infra/ or cloud/), drop a one-liner here before merging.

maria: (command to tag & kick release for reference)
```
release-tool tag v2.4.3 && release-tool publish --pipeline release --notes-file /tmp/changelog.md
```

alex: Copy — will run that after you approve.

chris: I'll standby on the monitoring channel and will post any anomalies.

sara: Added marketing blurb to the release notes draft.

maria: Closing loop — thanks all, proceeding on the timeline unless something urgent pops up.
